Et factum est post mortem Moysi servi De: Now it came to pass after the death of Moses the servant of God, that the Lord spoke
filium Nun ministrum Moysi: the son of Nun, the minister of Moses,
surge et transi Iordanem istum tu et omn: arise, and pass over this Jordan, thou and all the people with thee, into the land
quem calcaverit vestigium pedis vestri: that the sole of your foot shall tread upon
a deserto et Libano usque ad fluvium mag: From the desert and from Libanus unto the great river Euphrates.
Nullus poterit vobis resistere cunctis d: No man shall be able to resist you all the days of your life: as I have been with Moses, so will I be with thee: I will not leave thee, nor forsake thee.
Confortare igitur et esto robustus valde: Take courage therefore, and be very valiant:
ut custodias et facias omnem legem quam: that thou mayst observe and do all the law, which Moses my servant hath commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayst understand all things which thou dost.
quam tradidit vobis Moyses trans Iordane: which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan: but pass you over armed
ante fratres vestros omnes fortes manu: before your brethren, all of you that are strong of hand,
donec det requiem Dominus fratribus vest: Until the Lord give rest to your brethren
et possideant ipsi quoque terram: and they also possess the land
quam Dominus Deus vester daturus est eis: which the Lord your God will give them:
et sic revertemini in terram possessioni: and so you shall return into the land of your possession, and you shall dwell in it, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you
toward the rising of the sun.
Responderuntque ad Iosue: And they made answer to Josue
Sicut obedivimus in cunctis Moysi: As we obeyed Moses in all things,
Qui contradixerit ori tuo et non obedier: He that shall gainsay thy mouth, and not obey all thy words, that thou shalt command him, let him die.
Only take thou courage, and do manfully.
filius Nun de Sethim duos viros explorat: the son of Nun, from Setim, two men, spies,
in abscondito et dixit eis: ite et consi: secretly: and said to them: Go, and view the land and the city
Hiericho. Qui pergentes ingressi sunt do: of Jericho. They went and entered into the house of a woman that was a harlot named Rahab,
Nuntiatumque est regi Hiericho: And it was told the king of Jericho,
Tollensque mulier viros abscondit et ait: And the woman taking the men, hid them, and said:
Cumque porta clauderetur in tenebris et: And at the time of shutting the gate in the dark, they also went out together. I know not whither they are gone: pursue after them quickly, and overtake them.
Ipsa autem fecit ascendere viros in sola: But she made the men go up to the top of her house, and covered them with the stalks of flax,
Nunc ergo iurate mihi per Dominum: Now therefore swear ye to me by the Lord,
et salvetis patrem meum et matrem, fratr: And that you will save my father and mother, my brethren and sisters, and all things that are theirs, and deliver our souls from death.
Dixitque ad eos ad montana conscendite: And she said to them: Get ye up to the mountains,
ne forte occurrant vobis revertentes ibi: lest perhaps they meet you as they return: and there lie ye hid three days, till they come back, and so you shall go on your way.
si ingredientibus nobis terram, signum: If when we come into the land, a sign
et ligaveris eum in fenestra: and thou tie it in the window,
per quam nos dimisisti et patrem tuum ac: by which thou hast let us down: and gather together thy father and mother, and brethren and all thy kindred into thy house.
